data: Is the repetition rate of the ten-fold cross-validation for PPR(AT) consistently below PF(AT) throughout the distribution?

The question asks whether the repetition rate of the ten-fold cross-validation for PPR(AT) is consistently below PF(AT) throughout the distribution. From the analysis of the figure, the black line representing PPR(AT) is consistently below the grey line representing PF(AT). The lines do not intersect at any point in the range shown on the x-axis. Therefore, the repetition rate of PPR(AT) is indeed consistently below PF(AT) throughout the distribution.
